resources.string: QServe Terminal
Point this device at your restaurant

This app is a window onto the computer that runs your restaurant. Open the QServe console on that computer, go to Terminals, and print or show the station\'s code — then tap Scan below and point this device at it. You can also type the address by hand. This device remembers it.
The restaurant computer has to be running QServe, on the same Wi-Fi, with its licence activated. Before activation nothing is served to devices at all.
http://qserve-rest-000001.local:7020
